Test Requirements
GRE scores are not required
Letters of Recommendation 3
International Applicants Only TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo English Test score (no more than two years old)
Other Requirements
In addition to the University’s required application materials, applicants should refer to https://cs.unc.edu/graduate/graduate-admissions/ for additional information about applying to graduate programs in Computer Science, including details about specifying Areas of Interest and Faculty Interests and topics to include in your Statement of Purpose and Resume/CV.
*Only in unusual circumstances and after consultation with the director of graduate studies is admission for other semesters considered.
